Name: Switch Purpose
Description: 开关选择器表示两种相互对立的状态间的切换

Name: Switch Scenario
Description: 用于功能开启关闭/状态切换等场景

Name: Switch Behavior
Description: 点击开关切换开启关闭状态

Name: Unchecked Handle Left
Description: 关闭状态滑块左侧偏移2px

Name: Checked Handle Right
Description: 开启状态滑块右侧偏移2px

Name: Disabled Background Unchecked
Description: 禁用关闭状态浅灰背景

Name: Disabled Background Checked
Description: 禁用开启状态浅蓝背景

Name: Disabled Handle Background
Description: 禁用状态滑块白色背景

Name: Guideline Label
Description: 开关应添加标签说明功能

Name: Guideline Default State
Description: 根据业务设置合理默认状态

Name: Guideline Confirm Action
Description: 重要操作可添加二次确认

Name: Guideline Loading Feedback
Description: 异步操作显示加载状态
